evidence: Scanned non-generated C# and source project/configuration files for passwords, tokens, credentials, fixed crypto keys, cryptographic APIs, permission/ACL assignments, authentication/authorization, audit/logging APIs and diagnostics. Read Web.config, App.config, environment connection-string provider, mutation operations and configuration transforms. No hard-coded password, credential or cryptographic key found; local database connection text contains no password. No explicit unsafe ACL/permission assignment confirmed (absence of authentication is not relabeled as an ACL finding). External IIS/OS ACLs, environment secret values and deployment logging were not available. No secret values reproduced.
Assessment execution duration was not measured; execution_time_seconds is null rather than a fabricated duration.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

evidence.explanation: CatalogService.CreateCatalogItem, UpdateCatalogItem, RemoveCatalogItem and CreateAvailableStock modify catalog or stock data via WCF and call SaveChanges without an audit event recording actor, target, action or outcome. No application logger, EventLog/Trace audit calls or WCF diagnostic audit configuration is present in reviewed source/config. IIS request logs, if enabled externally, would not establish per-record mutation details; external deployment logging was not inspected.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 1 FOUND, 4 NOT_FOUND
